notes.notes:

notes.title: Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Can you celebrate Christmas by fighting aliens?

Starting today and throughout the Xmas season, both  demo & full game are modified with Santa hats for every Darsanaut! What are you waiting for? #FelizNavidad #HappyHolidays
